sources.liveLoads: BNBC 2020 Part 10 Sec 1.3.2.3 (gazette p. 5003): the detail engineering assessment of factory buildings takes 3 kN/m² on manufacturing floors and 6 kN/m² on stacking and storage areas; a retrofit design takes the loads of Part 6

sources.linear: SAEngine practice (ASCE 41-17 Sec 7.4.1, 7.5.2 and the m-factor tables of Ch 10 basis)

sources.tier1: SAEngine practice (the ASCE 41-17 Tier 1 checklist topics)

basis: SAEngine practice, ASCE 41 basis (BNBC 2020 Part 10 Sec 1.3.2 asks for the analysis, without a method)

knowledge.label: Minimum (drawings or a limited survey)
knowledge.note: Linear procedures only (SAEngine practice, ASCE 41 basis).

hazards.label: The design earthquake of Part 6 (BNBC's 2/3 of the maximum considered)
The maximum considered earthquake (1.5 × the design earthquake)

rcBeam.note: Primary members; beams controlled by inadequate development or embedment are not covered (the bars are taken as developed).

rcColumn.note: Primary members; a column whose shear strength is below the shear at its flexural strength is taken as force-controlled (m = 1, SAEngine practice).

linear.note: The seismic forces of the analysis (the design forces, reduced by R and multiplied by I) are made the unreduced forces of the hazard: × R/I × the hazard's spectrum scale × C1·C2·Cm for deformation-controlled actions, × R/I × the scale × Cm/J for force-controlled ones. Members are primary. SAEngine practice on the ASCE 41 basis: BNBC 2020 gives no assessment procedure.

nonlinear.note: The pushover hinges of the pushover table, their deformation limits times κ (SAEngine practice, ASCE 41 basis).

shear.note: The displacement ductility demand of a linear procedure is taken as the flexural demand over κ·MCE (at least 1, SAEngine practice).

jacketing.note: A concrete jacket with its bars anchored and the old surface roughened acts with the old member as one (monolithic) member (SAEngine practice on the EN 1998-3 A.4.2.2 factors).

frp.note: SAEngine practice on ACI 440.2R-17: the initial strain of the substrate is taken as 0 and the FRP force of flexural strengthening is reduced by ψf.

tier1.label: A complete load path for the seismic forces to the foundation
Clear distance to adjacent buildings against pounding
Interior mezzanines braced or anchored to the main structure
No storey weaker in strength than the storey above
No storey much softer than the storey above (soft storey)
The vertical elements continuous to the foundation
No large change of the plan dimension from storey to storey
No large change of the effective mass from storey to storey
The centres of mass and of rigidity close together
No visible deterioration of concrete or corrosion of bars
Quick check: average shear stress in the columns within the limit
Quick check: axial stress of the columns from overturning within the limit
No flat slab frames in the seismic force-resisting system
No columns restrained by infill walls or spandrels (short columns)
The columns' and beams' shear strength above the shear at their flexural strength
The columns at each joint stronger than the beams
At least two continuous top and bottom beam bars
Column bar laps long enough and enclosed by ties
Beam bar laps away from the joints and the hinge regions
Close column ties over the column ends
Close beam stirrups over the beam ends
Ties through the beam-column joints
Gravity columns able to follow the storey drift
Diaphragms continuous, without split levels or expansion joints
No large diaphragm openings next to the walls or frames
Columns anchored to the foundation for their tension
No liquefiable soils under the foundation
No slope failure or ground movement at the site
The foundation's width against overturning

note: BNBC 2020 asks for the structural analysis of an existing building (Part 10 Sec 1.3.2) and names strengthening and retrofitting (Part 7 Sec 5.10.3-5.10.4) without a method or values: every method and value of this table is SAEngine practice on the basis of ASCE/SEI 41-17 (knowledge factor, strengths, m-factors), ACI 440.2R-17 (FRP) and EN 1998-3 A.4.2.2 (jackets).
